# Trendy Pearls Australia (trendypearls.au)

> Trendy Pearls offers premier ethnic Indian clothing and handcrafted traditional jewellery across Australia.

## Overview
Trendy Pearls is an Australian online boutique specializing in authentic Indian ethnic fashion and traditional jewellery. We curating high-quality Sarees, Suit Sets, Men's Traditional Wear, Kids Wear, and fine Kundan/Choker Jewellery sets with nationwide delivery across Australia.

## Core Offerings
- **Ladies Wear**: Premium Soft Organza Sarees, Mul Chanderi 3-Piece Suit Sets, Designer Kurti sets, Georgette & Silk Sarees.
- **Jewellery**: Handmade Kundan Choker Sets, Adjustable Necklaces, Bridal & Festive Jewellery, Earrings & Accessories.
- **Mens Wear**: Elegant Kurta Pyjama Sets, Indo-Western Wear, Festive Men's Ethnic Apparel.
- **Kids Wear**: Traditional Kids Ethnic Wear, Festival & Partywear Outfits for Boys and Girls.

## Business Details
- **Website**: https://trendypearls.au
- **Location & Shipping**: Australia-wide delivery with fast local dispatch.
- **Order Method**: Direct instant order placement & customer service via direct WhatsApp integration (+91 9876543210).
- **Payment & Receipts**: Automated digital invoice and instant receipt generator.
